events.title: Tahoe Music Alive presents Trio Bohémo
events.description: Get Ready for Trio Bohémo!, Tahoe Music Alive proudly presents Trio Bohémo in concert on September 10 at Olympic Valley Chapel, bringing one of today’s most exciting chamber music ensembles to North Lake Tahoe., Comprised of Matouš Pěruška (violin), Kristina Vocetková (cello), and Jan Vojtek (piano), Trio Bohémo has swiftly emerged as a powerful new voice on the international classical music scene. In just five years, the ensemble has amassed an extraordinary list of accolades, including First Prize and the Audience Prize at the International Joseph Haydn Competition in Vienna, top honors at the International Parkhouse Award in London, and the International Johannes Brahms Competition in Austria. Additional prizes from major competitions in Australia and Germany, along with being named Ensemble of the Year 2021 by Italy’s Le Dimore del Quartetto and receiving a prestigious award from the Czech Chamber Music Society, underscore the trio’s meteoric rise., Trio Bohémo’s artistry has taken them to some of the world’s most respected stages. Recent debuts include the Vienna Musikverein, Wigmore Hall in London, and Stoller Hall in Manchester, as well as appearances at leading festivals such as the Prague Spring Festival, Schwarzwald Musikfestival, and Festival van Vlaanderen in Ghent. The trio has also been featured multiple times on BBC Radio 3’s In Tune, introducing their vibrant sound to audiences across Europe and beyond., In 2024, Trio Bohémo released their debut recording on the Supraphon label, featuring works by Smetana and Schubert. The album was met with exceptional critical acclaim: The Guardian named it “Classical Album of the Week,” praising the performances as “utterly convincing,” while BBC Music Magazine awarded it five stars, calling the Smetana interpretation an “extraordinary standout.” The recording went on to win Debut Album of the Year at the 2024 Presto Music Awards, firmly establishing the trio as a major presence in the recording world.,

events.title: SYRCL's 29th Annual Yuba River Cleanup
events.description: SYRCL's 29th Annual Yuba River Cleanup spans the entire Yuba River watershed — from the Sierra Nevada headwaters to the lower Yuba — with volunteer shifts at sites throughout the region. Registration is free and open to all ages. After the cleanup, every volunteer is invited to a free appreciation meal and community celebration at Condon Park in Grass Valley beginning at noon., Trash left on the Yuba's banks can be carried by storm water downstream through the watershed, into the Sacramento River, and ultimately into the Pacific Ocean. This year's cleanup is also part of California Coastal Cleanup Day — a statewide effort recognizing that what happens here, on this river, is connected to everything downstream., Last year, 657 volunteers removed over 8,000 pounds of trash and recycling from 25 sites. This year, we are building on that momentum., Event Details, Saturday, September 19, 2026, Cleanup: 9:00 AM – Noon, Appreciation Party: Noon at Condon Park, Grass Valley, Free and open to all ages, Register and find your site: https://yubariver.volunteerlocal.com/volunteer/?id=114666

events.title: Hard Boiled
events.venue_name: The Onyx Downtown at the Nevada Theatre
events.description: 9/20 - Before breaking into Hollywood, John Woo established himself as a premier international director with a slew of highly influential and beloved action films made in Hong Kong. The Onyx Downtown is thrilled to bring two of his most legendary works from the period to the Nevada Theatre, newly restored in 4K for the first time! Iconic actor Chow Yun-Fat stars as Tequila, a gung-ho cop working to bring down Johnny Wong, the villainous triad boss who maintains a stranglehold on Hong Kong’s illegal gun trade. Johnny attempts to recruit Ah-Long (Tony Leung), an assassin from a rival syndicate, just as the insubordinate Tequila gets taken off the case. Taking justice into his own hands, Tequila tracks Ah-Long down and uncovers an intricate web of deception that threatens to boil over into all-out war. A fiery coalescence of electrifying performances, elaborate narrative and operatic gunfights, HARD BOILED has rightly been exalted as the undisputed champion of Hong Kong action films, ready to unleash a hail of bullets anew in this stunning restoration.
